films.title: Colossal Youth
films.overview: After the Portuguese government demolishes his slum and relocates him to a housing project on the outskirts of Lisbon, 75-year-old Cape Verde immigrant Ventura wanders between his new and old homes, reconnecting with people from his past.

films.title: In Vanda's Room
films.overview: An unflinching, fragmentary look at a handful of self-destructive, marginalized people, but taking as main focus the heroin-addicted Vanda Duarte.

films.title: Horse Money
films.overview: While the young captains lead the revolution in the streets, the people of Fontainhas search for Ventura, lost in the woods.

films.title: Vitalina Varela
films.overview: A Cape Verdean woman navigates her way through Lisbon, following the scanty physical traces her deceased husband left behind and discovering his secret, illicit life.
